title: Partition-of-unity decomposition of a test form subordinate to an open cover of its support
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, let U ⊆ ℝ^P be an arbitrary set, let ι be a type, and let (V_i)_{i∈ι} be a family of open subsets of ℝ^P. Let ω ∈ Dⁿ(U), i.e. a C^∞ map from ℝ^P to the n-covectors of ℝ^P with compact support and spt ω ⊆ U, and assume spt ω ⊆ ⋃_{i∈ι} V_i. Then there are a finite set s ⊆ ι and test forms η_i ∈ Dⁿ(U) (i ∈ ι) such that spt η_i ⊆ V_i for every i ∈ s and ω = Σ_{i∈s} η_i in Dⁿ(U), i.e. pointwise as forms.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (ι : Type) (V : ι → Set (Eucl P)), (∀ i, IsOpen (V i)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, tsupport (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ ⋃ i, V i → ∃ (s : Finset ι) (η : ι → TestFormOn U n), (∀ i ∈ s, tsupport (η i : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) ⊆ V i) ∧ ω = ∑ i ∈ s, η i
